biography: Mike Millard's journey began not on the asphalt, but amidst the muddy fields of rural Oxfordshire. Growing up on his family's farm, he spent his youth tinkering with tractors and honing his mechanical skills. His passion for speed ignited when his father took him to a local karting track at age 12. He was instantly hooked, outperforming seasoned racers with his innate understanding of vehicle dynamics. Mike quickly rose through the ranks, winning regional championships and attracting the attention of DKS Engineering at 18. After a stint in Formula 3, his debut in the GT series was initially rocky, marked by a tendency to over-drive the car. However, under the guidance of veteran engineer, Sarah Chen, he refined his technique and adopted a more calculated approach. Now at 31, Millard is a consistent points scorer and a respected competitor, known for his level-headedness and unwavering focus.
drivingStyle: Millard is known for his smooth, precise driving style. He prioritizes consistency and tire management, often sacrificing outright pace in the early stages of a race to ensure he has grip when it matters most. He's exceptionally good at reading track conditions and adjusting his lines accordingly. While not the most flamboyant driver, his calculated approach and exceptional racecraft make him a formidable opponent, particularly in endurance races. He attacks corners with a focus on exit speed, setting up overtaking opportunities with clever positioning and patience.

rivalries.reason: A heated on-track battle at Silverstone in 2021 resulted in both drivers retiring, sparking a rivalry fueled by accusations of reckless driving.
A strategic disagreement regarding team orders at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2022 caused tension, with Millard feeling Rossi prioritized personal glory over team success.
Nakamura's aggressive defensive moves have repeatedly frustrated Millard, leading to several near-misses and a mutual lack of respect on the track.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of socks his grandmother knitted him.
Listens to classical music, specifically Bach, an hour before every race to calm his nerves.
Sharpens his pencils to an exact point before every practice session, a habit stemming from his days as a design student.
famousQuote: Racing isn't about pushing beyond the limit; it's about finding the limit and dancing with it.
careerHighlight: Winning the Spa 24 Hours in 2020, after a nail-biting final stint where he held off intense pressure from Ricardo Silva in the closing laps.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final hour of the Nürburgring 24 Hours in 2019 due to a sudden downpour, costing his team a guaranteed victory.
